name: data-profiler
purpose: Profile actual workbook/CSV structure before choosing mappings
sqlite: No direct integration; master stores checked artifact receipt
limitations: ConstructionDataProfiler is a Markdown example, not an installed import module
Do not eval Markdown
use_when: Tabular sources need profiling; otherwise explicitly declare not relevant

name: xlsx-construction
purpose: Construction spreadsheet layout and formula conventions
sqlite: Read approved projections, no new engineering observations
limitations: Markdown examples, not a CLI
Cost examples outside project scope; do not use
use_when: A requested spreadsheet is not already satisfied by the current package; use built-in spreadsheets skill for authoring/visual review

name: docx-construction
sqlite: Read reviewed package data, no approvals
limitations: Inline example functions are not importable APIs
Do not invent contract/commercial fields
use_when: Additional requested Word presentation; otherwise reuse generator's valid DOCX; built-in documents skill for rendering

name: pdf-construction
limitations: Original repeated-page-name split overwrites files
Original bookmark example is defective
Never run either example; use independently safe built-in PDF workflow
use_when: PDF is requested, not automatically for every project

name: pdf-to-structured
limitations: No OCR
Native text/reading order/table heuristics require review
use_when: No exact current extraction is already cached

name: dwg-to-excel
purpose: Read actual mapped CAD XLSX exports; inspect converter identity
sqlite: ETL ingest, original/export lineage separately retained
upstream: real exported workbook and explicit mapping
limitations: No functioning native DWG conversion
Probe/verify does not prove conversion or drawing-export lineage
use_when: An actual mapped export is supplied; direct DWG stays blocked

name: drawing-analyzer
purpose: Candidate tag occurrences and labeled metadata from PDF text
sqlite: ETL ingest; matcher can reuse SQL evidence
limitations: Text tags are not symbols, physical counts or verified room locations
use_when: Drawing evidence needs tag candidates; skip for specifications

name: specification-extractor
purpose: Preserve exact technical paragraphs and section/clause fragments
sqlite: ETL stores originals; reviewer index maps them later
limitations: Heuristic sections/continuations
No applicability approval or OCR
use_when: Native PDF specifications have not already been parsed

name: etl-pipeline
purpose: Validate/archive append-only evidence, mapped tabular intake and FTS5
upstream: exact evidence packages or actual tabular mappings
limitations: First active working version remains unreviewed
activate requires actual human revision decision
use_when: Validated extraction is not already persisted with the exact run signature

name: data-lineage-tracker
purpose: Inspect archive/source lineage and append actual reviewed corrections
sqlite: Existing records/reviews; never replace raw evidence
python_entry_points: add_review(db, record_id, reviewer, decision, reason, field=None, value=None)
limitations: Not authentication, RFQ approval or automatic conflict resolution
inspect initializes core schema through existing Store
use_when: Source lineage/correction inspection is needed; actual decisions use explicit decision gateway

name: data-quality-check
sqlite: Does not query DB directly; master adds read-only integrity audit and durable receipts
limitations: No findings is not approval
Unmapped BMS disciplines need explicit rules
use_when: Check actual supplied comparable evidence; never overwrite observations

name: mep-document-registry
purpose: Document/file/sheet identity, hashes, revisions and relationships
sqlite: Core 2 + registry migration 1; scan owns initial database creation
limitations: snapshot may create derived revision rows
Uncertain revisions are never applicable by default
DWG registration does not mean analysis
use_when: Start/update inventory; reuse identical analyses after byte/config verification

name: mep-equipment-matcher
purpose: Equipment imports, instance/type proposals and cross-document matching
limitations: Execution unvalidated
Queries may initialize schema
Occurrences/confirmed matches are not approved physical counts
use_when: Import only current missing equipment views; reuse stage 03/05 SQL rather than parse again

name: mep-cross-document-reviewer
purpose: Exact requirements, applicability candidates, comparisons and human technical review
limitations: Execution unvalidated
No universal clause/discipline applicability approval
Eight coverage scopes require actual review
use_when: Index existing SQL once, propose/compare, ask human for each actual approval

name: mep-technical-package-generator
purpose: Read-only reviewed equipment packages with strict readiness and immutable manifests
upstream: current engineering review; drafts may retain gaps
limitations: Execution unvalidated; private upstream facade provisional
English-first
RFQ always INTERNAL DRAFT, never sent
No system filter in package CLI; use exact entity scope
use_when: Generate only requested current components; checksum-reuse existing valid packages
